name: Wheel Strategy

on:
  schedule:
    # Every 15 minutes. GitHub does not guarantee exact timing -- during
    # high load, scheduled runs can be delayed by a few minutes. That's
    # fine for this use case.
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: {}   # lets you trigger a run manually from the Actions tab

# This is the cloud equivalent of the lock-file fix we added locally --
# GitHub will never run two instances of this workflow at the same time.
# If a run is still going when the next trigger fires, the new one waits
# in queue rather than racing against the first.
concurrency:
  group: wheel-strategy
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write   # needed so the workflow can commit state.json / log back

jobs:
  run-strategy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run wheel strategy
        working-directory: wheel
        env:
          ALPACA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.WHEEL_ALPACA_API_KEY }}
          ALPACA_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.WHEEL_ALPACA_SECRET_KEY }}
          EMAIL_ADDRESS: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_ADDRESS }}
          EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD }}
          NOTIFY_TO_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.NOTIFY_TO_EMAIL }}
          EMAIL_ADDRESS: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_ADDRESS }}
          EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD }}
          NOTIFY_TO_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.NOTIFY_TO_EMAIL }}
        run: python wheel_strategy.py

      - name: Commit updated state and log
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add wheel/state.json wheel/strategy_log.txt
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update wheel strategy state [skip ci]"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git pull --no-rebase origin main && git push && break
            echo "Push attempt $i failed (likely a race with another job), retrying..."
            git merge --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((RANDOM % 8 + 4))
          done
